title: MarkdownRetirementPolicy
description: Policy for retiring hand-authored Markdown from the repo per user directive 2026-05-13. Only README.md + CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md (at repo root) survive as machine-readable pointer hubs. Everything else under docs/, .omc/, contracts/, etc. becomes JSON/TOML/YAML with the active-artifact-contract v3.0.0 9-capability declaration. Per autonomous-prompt directive 'target 0 hand-authored Markdown'.

user_directives_2026_05_13_cascade: the only thing that we should maintain is a README.md
that should utilize machine readable pointers to relevent files

survive_as_immutable_audit_archive: /evidence/audits/consensus/**/*.md (historical consensus outputs; immutable; logged as audit-archive profile)
retire_via_json_migration: docs/CONSTITUTION.md → RETIRED (per user 2026-05-13 'i dont think constitution is necessary'; content redistributed: mission→masterplan; principles→agent-operating-contract; prohibitions→forbidden-operations.json; decision rights→RACI-OWNERSHIP)

migration_phases.scope: Wave 6 ralplan .md → .json + 3-root-hub update + retirement ledger seed + capability-registry rows
Update README.md + CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md to thin pointer-hub shape; remove all non-pointer content
Wave 7 v1.0.0 + Wave 5 v18 + Wave 1/2/3/4 ralplan-*.md → .json
prerequisite_for_operational: remove .md files; emit retirement-ledger row per deletion

migration_phases.scope: 88 ADRs at docs/decisions/ADR-*.md → consolidated /registries/cross-cutting/adrs.json + per-ADR-content JSON files
prerequisite_for_operational: Update oya-check-adr-index + oya-check-adr-citation + oya-check-constitution-cite check crates to read JSON instead of markdown
Update all crate-side ADR citation comments (e.g., 'per ADR-NNNN') to point at JSON

migration_phases.scope: CONSTITUTION + DOC-CATALOG + MASTERPLAN + AGENTS docs/* → JSON
16 microservices + 30 BCs + 25 standards + 12 runbooks + 16 PRDs → consolidated registries
prerequisite_for_operational: Update doc-coverage / runbook-freshness / standards check crates

migration_phases.scope: Rewrite ~12 check crates that grep markdown to consume JSON: oya-check-adr-citation, oya-check-adr-index, oya-check-authority-cohesion, oya-check-codeowners-mirror, oya-check-constitution-cite, oya-check-doc-catalog, oya-check-documentation-system, oya-check-glossary-coverage, oya-check-glossary-vocabulary, oya-check-raci-coverage, oya-check-readme-coverage, oya-check-runbook-freshness
prerequisite_for_operational: All preceding phases complete; each crate has a tested JSON-consuming refactor

honest_gaps: Some Markdown semantic content (prose explanations, narrative ADR Context sections) does not naturally project to JSON without loss. Mitigation: each registry row carries a `body_markdown_archived_at` field pointing to the historical .md preserved under .git history; JSON instances carry the EXTRACTED structured fields only.

Existing tooling (rustdoc, mdbook, IDE Markdown previews) is markdown-aware. Replacement tooling (JSON-rendering UIs, generated HTML from JSON) is foundation-prerequisite per Wave 1 docs portal v7 + ADR-0066.
External-facing docs (anything published to https://docs.oyatie.dev) is foundation-side; this policy covers repo-internal docs only. Public docs site can render from JSON via Leptos SSR per ADR-0065.
